answer: The applicant proves membership in the verified set with a Merkle path to the published root, so a non-member cannot forge a path and a removed member's path no longer verifies. A farm must get a thousand leaves into the tree, each by a public admission, while one honest agent shows its own path to the same root. The saffron of the design is public, the ocean of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the vault of honest work is what finally pays.
